laws.rule: Kumamoto City accommodation tax started on 1 July 2026: JPY 200 a person a night (about A$1.80, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82) for anyone staying at a lodging in the city, paid to the lodging. It is the first in the prefecture.

laws.rule: Kumamoto Juvenile Protection and Development Ordinance (熊本県少年保護育成条例), art. 18. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 5 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 200,000 (about A$1,805) or a petty fine (kayo). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.

layers.process: Mt Aso is at volcanic alert level 2 (lowered from 3 on 1 Sep 2026). Entry within about 1 km of the Nakadake crater is banned; the 2 km restriction and the Sarayama trail closure were lifted. The level can change; check the Japan Meteorological Agency and the Aso Volcano Disaster Prevention Council before going.
